# posts.create — POST /posts

Create a post

Creates a draft (`publishedAt: null`) owned by the current user. Publish it with `POST /posts/{postId}/publish`.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.posts.create({ body: { title: "Hello", content: "First post" } })
res.assert(201)
```

## Input
```ts
{ body: CreatePostDto }
```

## Responses
```ts
201: PostDto
400: ErrorDto // Empty title or content.
401: ErrorDto // Missing or invalid bearer token.
```

## Types
```ts
type CreatePostDto = {
  /** Post title, non-empty. */
  "title": string
  /** Post body, non-empty. */
  "content": string
}
type PostDto = {
  /** Post id. */
  "id": number
  /** Post title. */
  "title": string
  /** Post body. */
  "content": string
  /** Id of the user who created the post. */
  "authorId": number
  /** When the post was published. `null` while the post is a draft. */
  "publishedAt": string | null
  /** When the post was created. */
  "createdAt": string
}
type ErrorDto = {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  "statusCode": number
  /** Error message. Validation errors (400) return a list: one message per failed constraint. */
  "message": string | Array<string>
  /** HTTP status text, e.g. "Not Found". */
  "error"?: string
}
```
